meta_description: How Ayurvedachalam collects, uses, stores and protects personal information, under Alberta's Personal Information Protection Act. Contact and complaints.

data.md:
*Last reviewed 21 October 2026. Draft for legal review.*

Ayurvedachalam ("we", "us") is a private Ayurveda, massage therapy and spiritual healing practice in Calgary, Alberta. This policy explains what personal information we collect, why, how we protect it, and your rights, in line with Alberta's *Personal Information Protection Act* (PIPA) and, for email marketing, Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL).

## What we collect, and why

**On this website.** The contact form collects your name, email, phone number if you give it, and your message, so that we can reply. We ask you not to include health details. The newsletter form collects your email address, the exact consent wording you agreed to, the date, and the page you signed up from. Our web server keeps standard access logs (IP address, pages requested, browser type) for security and to keep the site working.

**When you book.** Booking, intake forms, appointment reminders and receipts are handled in our practice-management system, a separate service with its own security and privacy terms, which we will name here when it is confirmed. The intake form collects contact details and the health information a practitioner needs to see you safely: medications, allergies, relevant conditions and history. We collect only what is needed for that purpose.

**During care.** We keep clinical notes of consultations and therapies: what you told us, what we observed, the plan, and what was done. Massage therapy records are kept to the standard required by the practitioner's professional association.

**Analytics.** We use Google Analytics to understand how the site is used in aggregate. It sets cookies; you can block them in your browser without affecting the site.

## How we use it

To provide and record your care, to contact you about appointments, to answer your questions, to issue receipts, to send the monthly email you asked for, and to meet legal and professional obligations. We do not sell personal information and we do not share it with anyone for marketing.

## Who we share it with

Service providers that process information on our behalf: the practice-management and booking system, our email provider, our web host, and Google Analytics. Each is bound to use the information only to provide its service. Where a provider stores data outside Canada, we say so here: [to be completed once providers are confirmed]. We disclose personal information otherwise only when the law requires it, or with your consent, for example to send a receipt to your insurer at your request.

## Consent

By submitting a form, booking, or attending a session you consent to the collection and use described here. You may withdraw consent at any time, subject to legal and contractual limits; withdrawing consent for clinical records does not require us to delete records we must keep. Newsletter emails carry an unsubscribe link, and we act on it within ten business days as CASL requires.

## How long we keep it

Contact-form messages: up to 24 months. Newsletter consent records: for as long as you are subscribed, and two years after. Clinical and massage therapy records: [period required by the professional association, typically ten years from the last visit, and for minors until age 18 plus that period]. Web logs: 90 days.

## Security

Information on this site is sent over an encrypted connection. Clinical records are held in the practice-management system behind individual logins; website administration requires a password and a second factor. Paper notes, if any, are kept locked. We review access at least yearly.

## Your rights

You may ask to see the personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, and ask how it has been used and to whom it has been disclosed. Write to the contact below; we respond within 45 days as PIPA provides and may charge a reasonable fee for copies. If you believe we have not handled your information properly, tell us first; you may also complain to the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner of Alberta.

## Children

We provide services to people under 18 only with a parent or guardian present and consenting.

## Changes

We will post changes here with a new review date. Material changes will be announced on the site.

## Contact

Privacy contact: Maheswari Vedhachalam, Ayurvedachalam, Calgary, Alberta. Email: [privacy@ayurvedachalam.com]. Mail: [clinic address when confirmed].
